name: La Baguette
subtitle: Portable reversible bar with six documented grips

strands.provenance: Retained maker images show exterior end wraps. User review on 2026-10-01 corrected the model: there are no grooves; either shown wrap direction is acceptable. Smooth native end surface retained. Length, radius and station positions are display estimates; routes and settled height are solved against the native solid. Bearing station offset is the 20 mm native front/rear surface plus 1.2 mm cord radius and 0.2 mm solver clearance. A 0.001 mm numerical offset places the bearing station strictly outside the offset surface.
